text: A very clean and private wellness clinic with convenient parking. The doctor has a great eye for facial and skin concerns and gives excellent, honest advice when choosing treatments. Prices are very reasonable, with absolutely no forced selling. The atmosphere is comfortable and never awkward. Appointments are always on time, unlike other clinics I’ve been to where I had to wait for hours and was pressured into buying packages. If you’re looking for a clinic where the doctor doesn’t simply follow trends or push treatments, but truly provides personalized care and recommendations, I highly recommend this place. I’ll definitely be coming back

My husband and I are Americans from Miami, and we stumbled upon Sris through a mutual friend while honeymooning in Thailand. We had no idea we were about to have one of the best medical aesthetic experiences of our lives.

Dr. Mook is simply exceptional. She’s knowledgeable, refreshingly transparent, and most importantly… she’s not trying to sell you anything you don’t need. I came in asking for Botox, and she looked me over and told me honestly that I wasn’t ready for it yet. That kind of integrity is rare anywhere, let alone at this price point.

Between the two of us, I had the Doublo treatment and absolutely loved the results. My husband’s Botox came out flawlessly natural, exactly what you hope for. The clinic itself is spotless and modern, and the overall experience felt elevated in every sense.

For context: I’ve had work done at high-end practices across Miami and have tried most of what’s trendy in the US. This surpassed all of it. If your aesthetic is “effortlessly natural” the kind where no one can tell” this is your place.

We will absolutely be scheduling a visit on our next trip to Thailand. Worth coming to Chiang Mai for alone.
